episodes.title: The First Word I Wrote Down Watching Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders Was 'Cult'
episodes.description:
This week, we get into all three seasons of America's Sweethearts: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders, from the audition process that breaks your heart, the five-year ceiling, the pay fight, and the slow transformation from Season 1 to Season 3 of women who were reflections of a brand becoming individual stars the brand can no longer control. 

Also discussed: whether the DCC is a cult, beauty standards, and parallels with K-pop.
